newsitem.title: USA: Fifth Third to buy back 3 pct of shrs.
newsitem.headline: Fifth Third to buy back 3 pct of shrs.

text.p: Fifth Third Bancorp said on Wednesday that it has started to buy back up to three percent of its 105.9 million total shares outstanding.
The stock repurchases are to fund the company's stock option, dividend reinvestment and employee stock purchase plans.
The company's purchases are initially expected to be approximately 350,000 to 450,000 shares, Fifth Third said.
Fifth Third said it will also repurchase shares from shareholders with fewer than 100 shares, allowing them to sell their holdings without a commission charge.
Approximately 3,000 shareholders are elibible for this offer, which is aimed at reducing shareholder expenses, Fifth Third said.
